name: light-blueprint
summary: Near-white page with a flat #007BFA primary blue, pure black type, blue-grey soft shadows, an accent haze in two opposite corners and a barely-there fine grid; no glow, no bloom, hard cuts.
evidence: R4 t=6.0/7.0/13.0/14.0/14.8 bg median #FDFDFD (253,253,253) over the 30 % lightest pixels of each frame; t=12.2 and t=0.2 give (253,251,254). t=14.0 flat white region (150..600, 40..160): high-pass (gaussian r=3) std 0.02 levels -> grain 0; centre vs edge luminance 252-253 outside the haze -> vignette 0
R4 t=1.0 'Connect' and t=14.0 sentence: median of the darkest 1-5 % text pixels = (0,0,0) -> text #000000; t=0.2 'Co' (10,9,11)

R4 t=7.0 accent pill fill (1,123,251) sampled 8x27 at (304,295) and (626,295), flat top-to-bottom (0,122,248)/(0,123,249); t=4.0 ripple core (0,124,255); t=9.0 UI section bg top-left (1,123,250) -> accent #007BFA
